title: Medieval Castle
blurb: A fortress holding a mountain pass: a stone bridge over a gorge to a gatehouse between round towers, a curtain wall and a keep. The B6 rebuild in progress, then the earlier B5 pass, along the same 20-second camera path.
status: In progress. B6 is a partial assembly for a showing: saved modules beside unsaved draft gate towers and keep, grey stand-ins and a river sheet floating above the gorge. A Unity build of B6 is still to come.
cardAlt: The B6 castle from above the gorge: a gatehouse between two round gate towers with conical roofs, a curtain wall and a tall keep behind, a long arched stone bridge in front, and a flat green river sheet floating in the gorge.

videos.caption: B6, in progress: Holodeck's React Three Fiber viewer, captured with WebGPU. The gate towers and keep are unsaved drafts and the grey blocks are stand-ins. It also renders with WebGL2 when that is forced.
The earlier B5 pass, a flat blockout on stamped terrain, in the same viewer along the same camera path, captured with WebGPU.
Unity, earlier B5 pass: Unity 6 with URP on Vulkan, as the project is configured, with no anti-aliasing.

title: Firearms Through Time: Colt M4 at the range
blurb: A first-person range game whose rules run in two engines from shared fixtures. The same M4 sequence in Unreal and in the browser: aim, a semi round, a held 3-round burst, a short pull the cam remembers, inspect, reload, bursts until dry, and the empty reload.
status: In progress. Playable here: F or click fires, X takes a gun off the wall rack. Placeholder range art, Unreal still shows its test readout, and the reload is mostly below the view.
cardAlt: Two first-person views of the Colt M4 aimed at a paper target on an indoor-style range: Unreal on the left, the browser on the right.

videos.caption: Unreal Engine 5.8 editor game, recorded during the automated M4 check run (57 checks passed). The on-screen text is that run's test readout.
Holodeck in Chromium on WebGPU, driven by a script with the same action order.
